question: Which book written in Kannada received the 2025 International Booker Prize?

options.text: The Girl with the Seven Lives

solution: The correct answer is __**Heart Lamp**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Heart Lamp**, a book written in Kannada, was awarded the prestigious **2025 International Booker Prize**. • The **International Booker Prize** is a globally recognized award that honors outstanding works of fiction translated into English, celebrating the collaborative efforts of authors and translators. • This recognition highlights the rich literary tradition of Kannada literature, bringing global attention to the language and its creative heritage. • The book's themes, narrative style, and cultural depth were highly commended by the jury, showcasing the universal appeal of regional literature. • The translator of **Heart Lamp**, whose efforts made the book accessible to a global audience, also received equal recognition and a share of the prize money.
